name: SAML role trust with an audience check but NO subject-narrowing condition -> HIGH (broad, analogous to a broad OIDC subject)
note: IAM-804: SAML federated trust is handled analogously to OIDC. saml:aud is recognized as a valid CONSTRAINT, but absence of a subject-scoping condition (no saml:sub) leaves the federated subject broad, so severity is HIGH by analogy with a broad OIDC subject (trust-policy-semantics 4.5). The analyzer classifies the trust text only - it never asserts a specific SAML assertion would be accepted at runtime - and the assumed role's permissions remain out of scope / unknown.
